title: fix(metadata-protocol): two namespaces' stored permission sets of one name are each kept and served at their own package
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"zhuangjianguo"} -->
_Requested by **Steedos** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb?thread=cmsg_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9UbbBePzY6g11h3hyWk5ud4vWy)_

Fixes #32780

Clause-②: yes (widening) — widened: a save, publish or restore of a permission set whose name a package of another namespace stores moves from `422 NAMESPACE_CONFLICT` to saved; and a restart over a stored set of one package beside a set of the name another namespace's package ships or declares moves from a boot refused with `422 NAMESPACE_CONFLICT` to a boot that serves each package's set at its package.
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:权限集按「包 + 名称」各自存放;不同命名空间的两个包可以各自保存同名权限集,各自在自己的包下生效,重启后同样如此;同命名空间、平台命名空间等原有拒绝(含冷启动拒绝)全部保留,拒绝提示改为写入方自己能做的步骤。
- 为什么改:原来同名的已存权限集只能占一个全局位置,第二个命名空间的保存被误拒,重启时只要另一命名空间的包也发布了同名权限集就拒绝启动,与 ADR-0150 D2 的「包 + 名称」规则不符。
- 风险与回滚:风险在权限集名称的持有者判定;本 PR 让每一道名称检查都把包的已存权限集算作该包的持有,只放开不同命名空间之间的情形。回滚即 revert 本 PR,无数据迁移。
- 先看:`packages/objectql/src/registry.ts`(持有者读取与冷启动检查),`packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-registry-hydration.ts`(已存行进入所属包的位置),`packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-save-door-refusals.ts`(保存门判据与提示)。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/objectql exec vitest run src/protocol-permission-set-name-registry-reading.test.ts`,预期全部通过,其中 `[#32780]` 一组覆盖两种保存顺序、重启、删除、锁和保留的拒绝。
- 需要你做的:评审本次声明的放宽(保存门与重启两处)。

## What changes

A permission set is `(package, name)` (ADR-0150 D2).

- **`metadata-protocol` boot hydration and save write-through** (`protocol-registry-hydration.ts`): a stored permission row bound to a package now takes that package's own registry slot, as the other package-slotted types already do (#33127). `flow` stays where it was. The stored set stays its own package's tenant-authored set, so the packaged-permission-set lock reads only a shipped set as packaged.
- **`metadata-protocol` save door** (`protocol-save-door-refusals.ts`): two holders of a name are judged by the one namespace predicate (`permissionSetHoldersMeet`) alone. A stored holder no longer counts as conflicting whatever its namespace. The refusal that stays names steps the writer can take (rename its own set, or delete a set the environment or another package stores), never an edit inside another package. Envelope unchanged.
- **`objectql` name checks** (`registry.ts`): a package's overlay slot counts as a holder of its name at the package door and the item seam, under the one predicate. At the cold boot (ADR-0048 N.3, kept), a stored set held against a package that declares or ships the name is the environment's, and the boot refuses as before: the declarer's own stored set, or one of a package that meets it under the predicate. A stored set of a package of another namespace holds nothing against it.

## FROM → TO

All rows were measured on `main` (`479d1e4817` sources) and on this head, in the same harness: the kernel's cold boot, the protocol's save door and the authorization resolver.

| Case (packages `crm`, `hr`, `fin` of three namespaces) | FROM (main) | TO (this PR) |
|---|---|---|
| `hr` saves, publishes or restores a set of a name `crm` stores | `422 NAMESPACE_CONFLICT` naming `crm` | saved; each package's grant confers its own set |
| `crm` declares the name; `hr` saves, then `fin`, then `crm` its own | `hr`'s saved; `fin`'s `422` naming `hr` | each saved and served at its own package |
| restart over a set `hr` stores beside a set of the name `crm` ships | boot refused, `422 NAMESPACE_CONFLICT` | boots; `crm`'s grant confers the set it ships, `hr`'s the set it stores; only `crm`'s reads as shipped |
| restart over a set `hr` stores beside the name `crm` declares | boot refused, `422 NAMESPACE_CONFLICT` | boots; `hr`'s grant confers its set |
| restart over two packages' stored sets of one name, either row order and install order | not reached (the second save was refused) | each package's grant confers its own set; neither reads as shipped |
| delete of one of two packages' stored sets | not reached (the second save was refused) | retires that package's slot alone; the other set stays served, also after a restart |
| a package of the SAME namespace declares or registers a name another package stores, in either order | `422 NAMESPACE_CONFLICT` | `422 NAMESPACE_CONFLICT` (unchanged) |
| cold boot over a stored set held against a package that declares or ships the name (same namespace, or the declarer's own) | boot refused `422` | boot refused `422` (unchanged) |
| save refusal: same namespace, a platform namespace, no namespace, the environment | `422`, remedy "rename it in package …" | `422` (unchanged), remedy names the writer's own rename or a deletable stored set |
| grant naming no package of a name two packages hold | confers nothing (ADR-0150 D3) | confers nothing (unchanged) |
| package-less stored permission row | bare entry | bare entry (unchanged) |

## Tests

New and moved pins (all at head `d314ad0fb0`):

- `packages/objectql/src/protocol-permission-set-name-registry-reading.test.ts`, describe `[#32780] two namespaces' stored permission sets of one name: each served at its own package`:
  - Both save orders: both sets land, each package's grant confers its own set, a grant naming no package confers nothing, and neither set reads as shipped. All of that holds after a restart in either row order and install order.
  - A delete of either set retires that package's slot alone, also after a restart.
  - `crm` declares the name, then `hr`, `fin` and `crm` save: each lands and each is served at its own package. A restart beside `crm`'s declared name serves `hr`'s and `fin`'s sets.
  - A set `hr` stores before `crm` ships the name: after a restart, each package's grant confers its own package's set.
  - A package's stored set counts as its holding of the name. A package of the same namespace declaring or registering the name after it is refused, and before it the save is refused.
  - A cold boot over a package's stored set is refused when a package of the same namespace declares the name. CONTROL: one of another namespace boots.
  - A cold boot over a stored set held against a package that ships the name is refused.
  - ADR-0048 N.3: a stored set bound to the declaring package refuses the restart.
  - CONTROLs: the same-namespace save refusal and the install-declared refusal, both with remedy text.
  - The earlier pin `crm + hr where crm STORES its set` is flipped to admitted.
- `packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/packaged-permission-set-lock.test.ts`: a stored permission set in its package's registry slot is never read as shipped.
- `packages/objectql/src/webhook-stored-row-boot-hydration.test.ts` and `protocol-registry-heal-packageless-refusal.test.ts`: `permission` now reads as a type whose bound row takes its package's own slot.
- `packages/objectql/src/protocol-boot-hydration-scoped.test.ts:432` (ADR-0048 N.3) is unchanged and green.

<details><summary>Restart answers measured on main and on this head, same harness</summary>

The three edited sources were checked out at `479d1e4817` (`main`, blob-verified), `metadata-protocol` was rebuilt, and the same harness was run. Then everything was restored to `HEAD` (blob-verified, `git diff HEAD` empty) and rebuilt.

- `hr` stores, then `crm` ships the name, restart: on `main` the boot is refused `422 NAMESPACE_CONFLICT` in both row orders. On the head it boots, with `crm` conferring the set it ships, `hr` the set it stores, and a grant naming no package conferring nothing.
- `crm` declares the name, `hr` saves, restart: on `main` the boot is refused `422`. On the head it boots, and `hr` confers its set.
- `crm` saves, then `hr` saves: on `main` `hr`'s save is refused `422` naming `crm`. On the head it is saved, and each confers its own set before and after a restart.
- In the running kernel, `hr` saves, then `crm` registers its set: identical on both, with each confers its own set and a grant naming no package conferring nothing.
- `crm` saves alone, restart: identical on both.

No answer `main` gives moves to a refusal: the earlier declared narrowing read a hydration without the kernel's cold boot, and is withdrawn.
</details>

<details><summary>Ablation (each leg red, then restored; blob == HEAD and `git diff HEAD` empty after each)</summary>

Each leg goes through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`. The `metadata-protocol` legs rebuild the package and prove the marker is in `dist/` with `scripts/ablation-dist-preflight.mjs`. After a restore build, `--absent` proves every marker is gone. The `objectql` legs edit source the suite reads directly.

- L1, put back the stored-holder refusal at the save door: 8 failed.
- L2, leave `permission` out of package slotting: 5 failed `objectql` and 2 failed `plugin-security`.
- L3, remove the own-package guard of the boot hydration: 3 failed `objectql` and 1 failed `plugin-security`.
- L4, the old remedy text: 2 failed.
- L5, the namespace predicate never meets: 10 failed.
- L6, a stored permission row does not state tenant authorship: 3 failed `objectql` and 3 failed `plugin-security`.
- L7, the cold boot ignores the declarer's own stored set: 2 failed (the N.3 pins).
- L8, the package door and item seam ignore an overlay slot: 1 failed, the stored-set-as-holding pin.
- L9, the cold boot ignores a slot of a package that meets the declarer: 1 failed, the same-namespace cold-boot pin.
- L10, the cold boot ignores a slot served as the declarer's: 1 failed, the shipped-name cold-boot pin.

The first attempt of L1, L3, L5 and L6 did nothing: its string markers were constant-folded out of `dist/`, and the preflight refused. All four were redone with markers the build keeps.
</details>

## Acceptance notes

- `objectql/src/registry.ts` is in scope per the seat's rulings (6905396672). It changes only private members: the holder reading at the package door and item seam, and the cold-boot check.
- Outside this PR (#34226): the managed-package seal at the save door and the packaged-permission-set lock gate both judge by name alone.
